name: FX Channel Indicator
author: Jonathan Robichaud
description: Shows which mixer channel the FX unit is on (CH 1-4 or MASTER) next to the effect name, blinks that channel's headphone CUE LED, and adds an optional band mode for the FX frequency control (Settings > Fx > FX Frequency): tap LOW / MID / HIGH in any combination (LOW + HIGH, MID alone, or none at all), or step through them with the FX knob; the selected bands light green while the FX is on. The effect is kept to the chosen bands by a small library the mod loads into Engine (Engine restarts once when the mod is first enabled). Built for EngineX OS 5.3.0.5 on SC LIVE 4 (reverse jog is in EngineX's own Settings > Device).
